svg.text: A Theoretical Analysis of the Test Error

g.title: This work sharply analyzes the test error of finite-rank kernel ridge regression
g.desc: work sharply analyzes test error finite-rank kernel ridge regression, the model behind tuning a frozen network last layer
g.text: We sharply analyze the test error of finite-rank KRR — the model behind
tuning a frozen pre-trained network's last layer.

g.title: Derives matching upper and lower bounds that stay tight for any regularization
g.desc: derives matching upper lower bounds stay tight any regularization including ridgeless limit
g.text: Non-asymptotic and two-sided — tight for any regularization, including the ridgeless limit.

svg.text: Tin Sum Cheng · Aurélien Lucchi · Ivan Dokmanić · Anastasis Kratsios · David Belius
University of Basel · McMaster University · Vector Institute · UniDistance Suisse
